name: etsy-ultimate-data-extractor
title: Etsy Ultimate Data Extractor (All-in-One)
description: Five Etsy scrapers in one: keyword and category product search, shop analytics with the full catalogue, deep product detail with variants and stock, reviews with buyer photos and Etsy's AI sentiment tags, and a chained deep crawl that runs the lot from one keyword. Robots-compliant, no login, currency pinned per locale.
